Title: Automation: Graphical authoring adds runbook input as data source

Body.Content:
In addition to the features released last week for Azure Automation, we have added another one:
  • Runbook input parameters are now a data source for configuring activity input parameter values
With this new data source, all of the data sources that make it easy for you to configure activity parameters are in place.
Activity Parameter Configuration Data Sources
Data Source Runbook Input
We would love to hear your feedback and suggestions. Please tell us what you think in Azure User Voice.
